payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over lamp powers > longest blocked streak; for each, greedily place lamps at the furthest unblocked position reachable, simulating coverage from left to right using a precomputed prev array.
payload.rationale: The algorithm fixes a lamp type and then uses a sweeping greedy algorithm (like jump game with obstacles) to cover the line; no exchange argument is implemented, just a forward scan with a pointer.
